notes.note: Fix round: MemorySwapMax=0 now applies only where 1536 MiB fits in 1/8 of RAM (12 GiB and up); smaller hosts get MemorySwapMax=infinity, matching controlPlaneProperties and its boundary tests (12 GiB gives 0, 12 GiB minus 1 MiB gives infinity with 1535 MiB). MemoryLow is qualified as capped by ancestors under host-wide reclaim. The oomd sentence matches systemd.resource-control on systemd 259 (xattrs on user-owned cgroups are respected only for pressure candidates at or below user@.service, never for swap). The CPU 80% figure is limited to the case where only the two slices contend. The process fixture now asserts boot-applied MemoryLow, ManagedOOMPreference and slice CPUWeight; the guide makes no claim about that test.
